summary: Frontend-only verification of the redesigned Operational Vigilance Report at /vigilance (admin) and /employee/vigilance (vigilance employee). All redesign elements are present and functional: breadcrumb 'Vigilance / Operational Report', shield-icon page header, 2-row filter card with Reset, action toolbar (Filter primary, Download Sample Template / Upload Filled Sheet / Add Entry / Export / Help Guide secondary), 4 summary cards (Total Records=1113, Employees=51, Date Range=01-Sep-2026 → 24-Sep-2026, Research Entries=681 admin / 594 own), merged admin table with per-uploader break groups, grouped 'Employee / Attendance / Vigilance-Research' headers on own view, avatars w/ initials, icon row-actions (View/Edit/Delete) with tooltips, and pagination reading 'Showing X to Y of Z records'. All required data-testids are present. Interactive flows (filter, sort, pagination, rows-per-page radix select, Add/View/Edit/Delete dialogs, Help dropdown, employee-name clear) all work. Vigilance employee madhan.s sees the own-table with grouped headers and User Guide button. Normal user 'user/pass123' is correctly redirected away from both /vigilance and /employee/vigilance (no data leak). Mobile 390px layout stacks filters, wraps action buttons, and has no horizontal overflow (scrollWidth==innerWidth). Only 403 console noise is from unrelated notification-bell polling before login (pre-existing, not caused by this redesign).

integration_issues.issue: After changing rows-per-page to 50 and navigating to page 2, clicking vig-reset-btn reloads data with defaults (dates/dept/desig/team) but the pagination state (current page and rows-per-page) is NOT reset — record-count text still read 'Showing 51 to 100 of 1,113 records' after Reset instead of 'Showing 1 to 25'. Minor UX inconsistency; filter values themselves reset correctly.

action_items: (Optional/minor) On vig-reset-btn click, also reset page index to 1 and rows-per-page to the default (25) so the pagination text matches the new default filters.

(Housekeeping) Vigilance employee passwords (madhan.s / dinesh.t) drifted again in this environment — I resynced them to Vigil@123 (SHA256, method=agent_rbac_test_resync) so testing could proceed. Main agent may want to make the seed idempotent to stop the drift, per the note in /app/memory/test_credentials.md.
critical_code_review_comments: OperationalVigilance.js is 1257 lines — exceeds the >700-line threshold. Consider splitting SummaryCards, AdminMergedTable, VigilanceOwnTable, EntryDialog, PaginationBar, UploadProgressOverlay into their own files under /components/vigilance/ to improve maintainability.
Reset handler should also reset page/pageSize state, not just filter fields.
test_credentials: admin/HrAdmin@2109 (works). madhan.s and dinesh.t had drifted — resynced to Vigil@123 via mongo SHA256 during this run. user/pass123 correctly denied.
seed_data_creation: None. Only password resync for madhan.s and dinesh.t (data-level, existing accounts).
context_for_next_testing_agent: All redesign data-testids exist and work. If /employee/vigilance login fails as madhan.s/dinesh.t, resync passwords via python + hashlib.sha256('Vigil@123').hexdigest() into users.password_hash — this is expected drift per test_credentials.md. Ignore the pre-login 403s on notification-bell endpoints (unrelated to vigilance).
rca of the issue: Reset button only clears filter state (employee/dates/dropdowns) and refetches, but the pagination reducer keeps the last page/pageSize, so if the user was on page 2 with 50/page before Reset, the UI still reads 'Showing 51 to 100' post-reset even though the underlying dataset was reloaded from defaults.
